Prime Brothers are enhanced with the latest gene-mods, adapted from discoveries made after arriving in Sirius. The process that creates Prime Brothers gradually destroys the body, leaving them with significantly shortened lifespans. Despite this, many young soldiers still choose to become Prime Brothers, proudly dedicating their short lives to the Conduit and his cause. Battle Brothers were created by a visionary scientist, known as the Founder, who used a series of gene-mods in order to enhance soldiers beyond their human limits. [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/prime-brothers) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Primeborn: When units where all models have this rule are shot or charged from over 9" away and take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0). ### Special Rules Melee Slayer: When this model charges, its weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(3) or higher. Mend: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it. Precise: Gets +1 to hit when attacking. Ravage(X): When it's this model's turn to attack in melee, roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound. Re-Deployment: After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next. Re-Position Artillery: Once per activation, pick one friendly model within 6" with Artillery, which may immediately move by up to 9". Retaliate(X): When this model takes wounds in melee, the attacker takes X hits per wound taken. Shatter: Against units where most models have Tough(3) or higher, this weapon gets AP(+2). Shielded: Units where all models have this rule get +1 to defense rolls against hits that are not from spells. Unstoppable Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unstoppable against once (next time the effect would apply). Versatile Attack: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting or charging enemies over 9" away, all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls. ### Aura Special Rules Bane in Melee Aura: This model and its unit get Bane in melee. Bane when Shooting Aura: This model and its unit get Bane when shooting. Courage Aura: This model and its unit get +1 to morale test rolls. Melee Shrouding Aura: This model and its unit get Melee Shrouding. Rapid Rush Aura: This model and its unit get Rapid Rush. Regeneration Aura: This model and its unit get Regeneration. Versatile Reach Aura: This model and its unit get Versatile Reach. Read more ### Spells Advanced Sight (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which friendly units gets Unstoppable when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply). Mind Wound (1): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with Shatter. Blessed Ammo (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Shred when shooting once (next time the effect would apply). Lightning Fog (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 9", which take 4 hits each. Protective Dome (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Evasive once (next time the effect would apply). Psychic Terror (3): Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 9 hits with Bane. ### Units ### Heroes Grave Prime Master [1] Qua 3+Def 3+ 125pts CCW(A4) Fearless, Hero, Primeborn, Shielded, Tough(6)
